The Census 2027 portal reportedly listed ISKCON, Sanatan, Ramdev and Shri Ram under “Other” religions, before the entries disappeared. With claims of 287 religions being listed, questions are being raised about how religious identities will be recorded in the upcoming Census.
What does the “Other Religions” category mean, and how will the Census 2027 record religious identities?
Thank you for watching our video!
